title: Duke Energy Can Focus on Customer Needs with Oracle Platinum Services
description: Duke Energy relies on Platinum Services to diagnose and resolve issues in real-time 24/7 without our team's involvement, freeing our valuable resources to focus on high-value DBA work. It's an asset you don't want to be without—at no additional cost.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it is an enterprise technology testimonial about Oracle Platinum Services reducing manual support work and assisting with diagnosis, troubleshooting, and resolution of enterprise service requests. The presentation describes operational value and no additional cost rather than asking viewers to invest money, transfer funds, or provide credentials, and the interview format with Oracle closing branding is consistent with ordinary corporate promotion.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary subject is an ordinary enterprise IT support service described in a corporate testimonial, including automated support routing, issue resolution and system monitoring.
